messages.author: c5ac81d4b205db81
messages.subject: Methylation at uncovered loci
parts: I am processing multiple sample of RRBS data and using methylkit. How do u guys consider CpGs without any coverage ? The methylation there is 0 right ?

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: Methylation at uncovered loci
parts:
The CpGs with no coverage has no value of methylation, that doesn't mean they are 0. It means we can't know their methylation value. The CpGs without any coverage are not analysed.

Best,
Altuna
